4. It is stated in the plaint of Title Suit No. 31 of 1991 that the suit land originally belonged to Amorendra Nath and others who settled the same with one Abdus Sobahan and Abdul Hamid Howlader; that the said Abdus Sobahan died leaving behind his only son, the plaintiff No.1 and Abdul Hamid Howlader died leaving behind plaintiff Nos.2 to 5 as heirs. It is alleged that when the suit land was wrongly recorded in SA Khatian they instituted Title Suit No. 220 of 1959 and obtained a compromise decree on 10.8.1959, on the basis of which the plaintiffs got the suit land recorded in their names and since then they have been possessing the same. It is further alleged that the defendants fraudulently created an auction sale proceeding in respect of the suit land in Certificate Case No. 472 (KT)/83-84 but did not acquire any title or possession in the same. Hence, the suit. 

 13. The learned advocate for the appellants claimed that the suit land was not recorded in the names of the settlement holders in the SA Khatian and as a result they filed Title suit No. 220 of 1959 and obtained a compromise decree and by that decree the appellants made the record corrected and thereby included their names in the record and relying upon such submission the appellate court decreed Title Suit No. 31 of 1991 only on the basis of the said compromise decree [Exhibit-2(ka)] passed on 10.8.1959. But on examination of the plaint of Title Suit No. 220 of 1959, the solenama (Exhibit-2) and the Sole decree [Exhibit-2(Ka)] it transpires that there were two plaintiffs and seven defendants in the said suit but none other than Amarendranath (one defendant) and the sole plaintiff No.1, Abdul Hamed, signed the said solenama and the plaintiff No.1 alone put his signature at the bottom of the same. Interestingly neither the other six defendants nor the plaintiff No. 2, Abdul Subhan Miah, signed the said solenama. Moreover, the solenama was not proved by either party of the suit and there is no explanation as to why others did not sign that solenama. On the other hand PW-2, Subudh Chandra Majhi, in his cross examination admitted that “বাবুদের সহিত পত্তনের সময় কথা হইয়াছে যে, মোকদ্দমা করিলেই সোলে করিয়া দিবে। ঐ সময় অন্য বাবুরা বাড়িতেই ছিল।
